research_findings.title: Isotonic Calibration Outperforms Platt Scaling for Large Calibration Sets in Conformal Prediction
research_findings.key_insight: Isotonic regression corrects any monotonic distortion and outperforms sigmoid scaling when calibration set size >1,000 samples; Venn-Abers provides distribution-free coverage guarantees.
